text: Al Horford removed from Warriors injury report with back issue. Al Horford is trending after he was removed from the Warriors' injury report, a listing of players who may miss games because of injury, on Thursday. The removal came with a back injury.. Warriors reportedly withholding payments to Kristaps Porziņģis, sources say.. Al Horford, a Golden State Warriors player, was taken off the team's injury report on Thursday. The listing had been tied to a back injury. Removal from the report generally means a player is expected to be available.
